entries.headline: Gold deliveries jump to 552 contracts on Oct 16
entries.moved: 552 October gold (GC, 100 oz) contracts were delivered in the Oct 16 CME report. JP Morgan Securities' customer account issued 543 of them; the largest takers were Barclays (customer) 200, JP Morgan Securities (customer) 120 and BMO Capital Markets (house) 100.
entries.amount: About 55,200 oz (552 × 100 oz), roughly 1.72 tonnes. That is about 31% of the 1,767 GC contracts delivered in calendar October through Oct 16 (552 ÷ 1,767). The other 1,215 contracts were spread over the 11 October sessions from Oct 1 to Oct 15, about 110 a day on average.
entries.context: The Oct 15 report had no GC notices, so this is a jump after a quiet stretch. The CME October-contract cumulative, which also counts the Sep 29–30 first-notice days, is now 13,072 contracts. Silver was quiet the same day at 18 SI contracts (about 90,000 oz). Registered gold was 14.82M oz as of Oct 15; the next warehouse report is due Mon Oct 19, evening ET.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily Issues and Stops report, Oct 16, 2026)

entries.headline: Eligible silver up 1.45M oz; registered eases 260K
entries.moved: Eligible silver rose from 228.66M oz (Oct 12) to 230.11M oz (Oct 13). Registered fell 260,198 oz to 103.09M oz.
entries.amount: Eligible +1.45M oz; registered −0.26M oz; total COMEX silver 333.20M oz (+1.19M oz day over day).
entries.context: Net metal into vaults, with some reverse flow out of the deliverable (registered) category. Not a drawdown day.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)

entries.headline: Registered gold slips under 15M oz to 14.88M
entries.moved: COMEX registered gold fell about 170K oz from 15.05M (Oct 12) to 14.88M (Oct 13).
entries.amount: 14.88M oz registered, 8.60M eligible, 23.48M total. About −1.6% over 30 days.
entries.context: First print below 15M oz in this stretch of the series per The Vault Report. Daily gold deliveries remain light (8 standard GC notices on Oct 14; October-contract MTD 12,520 including late-September first notice).
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks); CME delivery MTD for notices

entries.headline: Silver deliveries pick back up: 120 contracts on Oct 13
entries.moved: 120 October silver (SI) contracts were issued and stopped.
entries.amount: About 600,000 oz (120 × 5,000 oz). October month-to-date: 3,250 contracts, about 16.25M oz.
entries.context: A rebound from just 1 contract on Oct 9 and 4 on Oct 12. Registered silver still rose over the same stretch, so new deposits outpaced delivery draws.
entries.source: Heavy Metal Stats (CME Group daily delivery notices)

entries.headline: Registered silver climbs to 103.35M oz
entries.moved: COMEX registered (deliverable) silver rose 593.8K oz in one day.
entries.amount: 103.35M oz registered, up about 7.8% over 30 days (from about 96.5M oz in mid-September).
entries.context: Registered is now about 31% of total COMEX silver. The trend has been steady additions, not drawdowns.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)

entries.headline: Eligible silver down about 7.8M oz in a week and a half
entries.moved: Eligible (stored, not deliverable) silver fell from 236.49M oz (Oct 2) to 228.66M oz (Oct 12).
entries.amount: About -7.8M oz (-3.3%). Total COMEX silver fell from 338.17M to 332.01M oz.
entries.context: Part of this offsets registered gains (metal re-classified as deliverable); the rest is net metal leaving COMEX vaults.
entries.source: The Vault Report (CME Group daily warehouse stocks)

entries.headline: Two-day silver delivery burst: 688 contracts on Oct 7–8
entries.moved: 330 SI contracts issued/stopped on Oct 7 and 358 on Oct 8.
entries.context: The busiest stretch of the October silver delivery month so far. It came as settlement dipped just under $60 and faded once prices rebounded.

entries.headline: Gold notices spike to 785, mostly micro contracts
entries.moved: 785 gold notices on Oct 8: 255 standard 100-oz (GC) and 530 Micro Gold.
entries.amount: About 25,500 oz from standard contracts plus about 5,300 oz from micros (10 oz each).
entries.context: Standard October gold month-to-date reached 12,329 contracts. Daily pace then slowed to 138 (Oct 9), 44 (Oct 12) and 1 (Oct 13).
